output.headline: Awards G & G Builders $176,134 for play area upgrades at Esperanza at Stonehurst Elementary

The amount includes a $21,500 general contingency allowance. Work started September 14, 2023, before this Board vote, and was to be finished by October 13, 2023.

output.summary: ER Plumbing & Construction of Alameda will dig the trenches that hold the electrical lines for the light poles at the new soccer mini pitches at Lockwood STEAM Elementary School. The work was scheduled to start October 26, 2023, which is before this Board meeting, and to end December 31, 2023.

output.summary: ER Plumbing & Construction of Alameda will build electrical infrastructure from the library to the outside soccer mini pitch courts at Allendale Elementary School for a fixed (lump sum) price. Work began September 14, 2023, before this Board vote, and is scheduled to end December 30, 2023.

output.summary: Professional Service Industries, Inc. (PSI) of Oakland will provide asbestos and hazard management services, including environmental consulting, building envelope consulting and testing, under the Asbestos Hazard Emergency Response Act (AHERA) project at various sites. The money supports prevention education for staff, students and caregivers, and putting the Human Trafficking School Safety Protocol into practice. This is a ratification, meaning the Board is approving an agreement whose period began August 22, 2023 and runs to May 24, 2024.

output.summary: Children Rising of Oakland will provide 400 hours of tutoring, in intensive sessions for literacy development, at Brookfield Elementary School. This is a ratification, meaning the Board is approving an agreement whose period began August 7, 2023 and runs to May 24, 2024.

output.summary: Instruction Partners of Nashville will provide English Language Arts, math and/or science instructional support at Elmhurst United, Bret Harte and Urban Promise middle schools through the Middle School Network. This is a ratification, meaning the Board is approving an agreement whose period began September 7, 2023 and runs to June 30, 2024.

output.summary: Health Initiatives For Youth (HIFY) of San Francisco will provide a 12-session program for teens ages 13 to 18 about how food and nutrition choices affect mood and wellbeing, at no cost to the district. output.summary: Girls Leading Goals of San Francisco will provide leadership and life skills training through soccer on ten Saturdays at Elmhurst United Middle School, supporting 80 to 100 students per session. output.summary: Rob Skate Academy of San Leandro will run a 9-hour Saturday skateboarding program for 10 weeks at Burckhalter Elementary School, supporting 80 to 100 students. output.headline: Hires Terraphase Engineering for $50,914 in environmental review for the Roosevelt Middle School project
output.summary: Terraphase Engineering, Inc. will provide California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) consulting services for the Roosevelt Middle School Modernization Project. output.summary: 2COACHU of El Cerrito will provide its Math Hoops program, which uses a board game, mobile app and curriculum built around basketball to teach math and social-emotional skills, with an end-of-season event on December 2, 2023. This is a ratification, meaning the Board is approving an agreement whose period began September 1, 2023 and runs to December 31, 2023.

output.summary: Hatchuel Tabernik & Associates, Inc. of Berkeley will help prepare 21st Century ASSETS Grant applications for McClymonds High School, Coliseum College Preparatory Academy and Skyline High School, including narratives, timelines, budgets, draft letters of agreement and help submitting to the California Department of Education. output.summary: The district is hiring EDesign-C, Inc. of Oakland to evaluate the existing electrical system and write a feasibility report on upgrading to solar equipment at Elmhurst United Middle School and Manzanita Community Elementary School.
